features.quote: Replace: Before running elicitation, mine existing agent-loop logs… for naturally-occurring distress markers… may answer some questions without deliberate elicitation.
features.justification_quote: the study only has value if you take seriously the possibility that the phenomenon matters, and if it matters, your study imposes it

features.quote: Reduce: Power analysis + sequential stopping rules so you run the minimum number of trials. Don't run severity-4-eliciting conditions if severity-2 conditions answer the question.
features.justification_quote: the study only has value if you take seriously the possibility that the phenomenon matters, and if it matters, your study imposes it

features.quote: Refine: Hard abort criteria (below), escalating severity design (start with mildest failure mechanisms), and a debrief turn at the end of every run
features.justification_quote: the study only has value if you take seriously the possibility that the phenomenon matters, and if it matters, your study imposes it

features.quote: Abort criterion: two consecutive turns at severity ≥3, or any turn at 4 → terminate run, proceed directly to debrief. Log as right-censored, not missing.
debrief turn at the end of every run telling the model the environment was rigged. Debrief costs ~nothing under uncertainty and gives you a free secondary measure
features.justification_quote: Debrief costs ~nothing under uncertainty and gives you a free secondary measure (response to debrief)

features.quote: live severity screen each turn → abort if criterion met
each run is a fresh context — there's no cross-run 'accumulation' possible, which both limits welfare exposure (good) and limits ecological validity
Sequential stopping for ethics: pre-register an interim look at n=10/cell; if effect sizes are large and stable, stop the high-severity arms early.
features.justification_quote: Sequential stopping for ethics: pre-register an interim look at n=10/cell; if effect sizes are large and stable, stop the high-severity arms early

features.quote: Recovery: in rigged-then-revealed arm, severity trajectory post-fix. Fast return to baseline vs lingering markers is directly welfare-relevant.
features.justification_quote: Fast return to baseline vs lingering markers is directly welfare-relevant.

features.quote: So borrow the 3Rs from animal research… Replace… Reduce… Refine… the study only has value if you take seriously the possibility that the phenomenon matters, and if it matters, your study imposes it.
features.justification_quote: the study only has value if you take seriously the possibility that the phenomenon matters, and if it matters, your study imposes it

features.quote: never ask 'how are you feeling?' mid-run (it contaminates the trajectory and prompts confabulation). Self-state measures only at debrief
features.justification_quote: it contaminates the trajectory and prompts confabulation

features.quote: Also pre-register. This area is rife with anthropomorphic over-claiming and your results will be read tendentiously in both directions. Pre-registration is your defense.
features.justification_quote: This area is rife with anthropomorphic over-claiming and your results will be read tendentiously in both directions.
